'''James Van Fleet''' (Jim Van Fleet) was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 15 and a Flight Leader in the Coruscant region, from Mifflinburg, Pennsylvania.<ref name="decsq-coruscant">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/coruscant.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Coruscant], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115091600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/coruscant.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> He finished 63rd in [[DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="dc99sw22_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101003044/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
